modules.title: Introduction to Isaiah and Jeremiah
modules.html:
Isaiah's Messianic prophecies; Jeremiah's call, suffering and message of the new covenant. This section covers introduction to isaiah and jeremiah.

Key points

  • The 'New Covenant' promised by Jeremiah was to be written on the... — Hearts of the people.
  • Isaiah’s call involved a vision of — God in the temple.
  • Jeremiah is known as the — Weeping prophet.
  • Isaiah prophesied that the Messiah would be born of a — Virgin.
  • God called Jeremiah while he was — In his mother's womb.

Worked examples

Q: The 'New Covenant' promised by Jeremiah was to be written on the...
A: Hearts of the people — Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Hearts of the people.

Q: Isaiah’s call involved a vision of?
A: God in the temple — Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: God in the temple.

quiz.q: The 'New Covenant' promised by Jeremiah was to be written on the...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Hearts of the people.

quiz.q: Isaiah’s call involved a vision of?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: God in the temple.

quiz.q: Jeremiah is known as the?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Weeping prophet.

quiz.q: Isaiah prophesied that the Messiah would be born of a?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Virgin.

quiz.q: God called Jeremiah while he was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: In his mother's womb.

quiz.q: Isaiah's lips were touched with?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: A live coal.

quiz.q: The disciple who betrayed Jesus was _____.
quiz.solution: Judas Iscariot betrayed Jesus to the chief priests for thirty pieces of silver.

quiz.q: The Great Commission instructs disciples to go and make disciples of _____.
quiz.solution: In Matthew 28:19, Jesus commanded the disciples to go and teach 'all nations'.

quiz.q: The first place where believers were called Christians was _____.
quiz.solution: Acts 11:26 notes that it was in Antioch that the name 'Christian' first came into use.

quiz.q: James teaches that 'Faith without _____ is dead'.
quiz.solution: James 2:26 emphasizes that true faith must be reflected in practical actions.

quiz.q: God's promise to Noah was sealed with a _____.
quiz.solution: The rainbow was the sign of the covenant that God would never again destroy the earth with a flood.

quiz.q: The mother of Samuel was _____.
quiz.solution: Hannah was barren but prayed fervently at Shiloh, promising to dedicate her son to the Lord.

quiz.q: The passover feast was instituted in Egypt to commemorate the _____.
options: sparing of the first-born of the Israelites
quiz.solution: The Passover was established so the Angel of Death would pass over the houses marked with lamb's blood, sparing the Israelite first-borns.

quiz.q: John the Baptist's message centered on 'Repent, for the _____ is at hand'.
quiz.solution: Matthew 3:2 records John preaching in the wilderness of Judea, announcing the proximity of the Kingdom of Heaven.

quiz.q: The request of the sons of Zebedee for positions of honor in Jesus’ kingdom showed their _____.
quiz.solution: James and John sought seats at the right and left of Jesus, failing to understand that greatness in His kingdom comes through service and suffering.

quiz.q: Before His ascension, Jesus commanded His disciples to wait in Jerusalem for the _____.
quiz.solution: Acts 1:4-5 records Jesus telling them to wait for the Holy Spirit who would empower them.

quiz.q: God's promise to Noah was symbolized by a _____.
quiz.solution: Genesis 9:13 describes the rainbow as the sign of the covenant that God would never again destroy all life with a flood.

quiz.q: God created man on day:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Sixth.

quiz.q: Resurrected on day:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Third.

quiz.q: Living sacrifice urged by:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Paul (Romans).

quiz.q: Temple built by:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Solomon.

quiz.q: Beatitudes found in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Matthew.

quiz.q: Who interpreted Pharaoh's dream?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Joseph.

quiz.q: Who was the tax collector that climbed a tree to see Jesus?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Zacchaeus.

quiz.q: Who is the author of the Book of Revelation?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: John.

quiz.q: James teaches that faith without works is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Dead.

quiz.q: John the Baptist baptized with:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Water.

quiz.q: The main reason why Adam and Eve were expelled from Eden was their...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Disobedience to God's command.

quiz.q: In the Beatitudes, Jesus said 'Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called...'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Children of God.

quiz.q: The 'Golden Rule' teaches us to...
options: Do to others as you would have them do to you
Love only those who love you
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Do to others as you would have them do to you.

quiz.q: Who helped Jesus carry his cross?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Simon of Cyrene.

quiz.q: Who was the mother of Samuel?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Hannah.

quiz.q: The Kingdom divided during the reign of:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Rehoboam.

quiz.q: Philip preached in:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Samaria.

quiz.q: The root of all evil is:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Love of Money.

quiz.q: Sower seed means:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Word.

quiz.q: Temple builder:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Solomon.

quiz.q: Sapphira died because:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Lied to Spirit.

quiz.q: The son of the promise born to Sarah was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Isaac.

quiz.q: Moses was not allowed to enter Canaan because he?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Struck the rock twice.

quiz.q: Hannah prayed to God for a son at?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Shiloh.

quiz.q: The Southern Kingdom (Judah) fell to the?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Babylonians.

quiz.q: Haggai and Zechariah encouraged the?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Rebuilding of the temple.

quiz.q: The "Valley of Vision" is a name for?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Jerusalem.

quiz.q: Which prophet was a herdsman from Tekoa?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Amos.

quiz.q: Nicodemus was a?
options: Pharisee who came to Jesus by night
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Pharisee who came to Jesus by night.

quiz.q: The "Last Supper" was a celebration of?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Passover.

quiz.q: The parable of the Sower describes?
options: How people receive the Word of God
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: How people receive the Word of God.

quiz.q: Stephen was killed by?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Stoning.

quiz.q: The goddess worshiped in Ephesus was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Diana (Artemis).
